     Spotted, or Poison Hemlock. Umbelliferæ.

     A native of Europe, but naturalized in the United States. The active principle is Conia, a yellowish, oily, transparent fluid, lighter than water, of an acrid, nauseous, tobacco-like taste. It is very volatile ; slightly soluble in water ; its combinations with acids do not easily crystallize, and are very soluble and poisonous. It was known in ancient times, but not used until recently as an internal medicine. It was employed in the execution of political offenders, and was the means of Socrates' death. Dioscorides recommended the dried plant to be applied upon the genitals, to remedy nocturnal pollutions, and upon the breasts of girls, to prevent their development. Pliny and Avicenna recommended poultices of it to remove tumors of breasts and testes, and to suppress the secretion of milk.

     Proved by Hahnemann and his provers ; see Encyclopædia, vol. 3, p. 519.

MIND. [1] [Con.]
Obtuseness of all the senses ; unconsciousness ; wandering about as if half asleep.
Extremely insensible.
Weak memory. θ Vertigo.

Dulness, like stupefaction, difficulty in understanding what he reads.
Inability to sustain any mental effort.
Tired, weary sensation in brain, with physical as well as nervous prostration.
Sensation in forehead or front part of brain like an inability to fix the mind on any subject ; loses hold of the idea and gets confused.
Buried in thought ; apprehensive respecting the present or future.
Insanity of a periodical or alternating type.
Imbecility more frequent than insanity.
Inclined to cry, sobs aloud when alone.
Likes to wear his best clothes, makes useless purchases, cares very little for things, wastes or ruins them ; does not want to work, prefers to play.
Picks his nose, which bleeds easily ; or picks his fingers ; lies in bed most of the time ; does not like to answer questions.
Involuntary laughing and weeping.
Dislike to society and yet a dread to be alone. θ Hysteria.
He is averse to being near people, and to the talk of those passing him ; is inclined to seize hold of and abuse them.
Patient averse to talking, dressing himself, taking food or seeing her children ; spleen enlarged. θ Melancholia.
Disinclination for business.
Mood serious ; unsympathizing, from indolence.
Complete indifference ; takes no interest in anything, particularly walking in open air. θ Hypochondriasis.
Great depression of spirits preceding menstrual period.
Alternate fits of silent depression and quarrelsome liveliness. θ Mania.
Sad and gloomy for days, then excited.
Great unhappiness of mind, recurring every fourteen days.
Easily disturbed by trifles, moved to tears ; anxious.
Solicitude concerning the future ; great concern about any little thing that may happen.
Hypochondriasis and hysteria from suppression of, or too free indulgence in, sexual instinct, with low-spiritedness, anxiety and sadness.
Hypochondriasis with suppression of menses.

Discouraged, despondent, and dissatisfied with herself and her surroundings.
Timid, cannot be persuaded to work ; want of proper will.

Very ill-humored in afternoon, from 5 to 6, as though a great grief weighed upon him, with paralyzed feeling in all the limbs, indifference and taking no interest in anything.
Morose mood ; everything about him impresses him unpleasantly.

Very much excited, passionate, domineering, quarrelsome, scolds and will not bear contradiction.
Inclination to start, as with fright.

Dyspepsia with acidity of stomach.
Cancer of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Con.]
Painful tension about hypochondria as from a constricting band.
Pressive, tensive pain in hypochondria ; stitching pains in hepatic region ; excessive colicky pains.
Aching in right hypochondrium, < by inspiration ; aching tension in left hypochondrium, extending low down in abdomen, with sensation of heaviness throughout abdomen.
Stitches or painful tearing in hepatic region.
Pain in liver with accumulation of earwax.
Pressing pain in right hypochondriac region, < from pressure, convex, hard swelling, extending towards precordial region and nearly to right crest of ilium. θ Enlargement of liver.
Constant pain in liver, with hardness and œdema. θ Uterine polypi.
Enlarged liver with pain on pressure ; jaundice.
Hard swelling of liver.
Chronic enlargement of liver or spleen, with torpid action of bowels.
Stitches in left hypochondrium and in spleen.
Enlargement of spleen. θ Melancholia.
Sudden attack of vomiting and diarrhœa at night ; vomiting of a white substance consisting of saliva without any admixture of contents of either stomach or bowels ; gouty diathesis. θ Acute inflammation of pancreas.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Con.]
Trembling of whole abdomen.
Flatulency ; incarceration of flatus ; rumbling and grunting in abdomen.
Fulness in abdomen, early in morning when awaking.
Fulness and bearing down in abdomen. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Heaviness and pressure in abdomen or perineum.
Inflation of abdomen after meals, particularly after milk.
Swelling of abdomen.
Swelling in region of pylorus.
Hardness and distension of abdomen with frequent sour evacuations ; < during night, > by day.
Hardness of abdomen from swelling of mesenteric glands.
Sensation as if he must take hold of abdomen when coughing ; feels as if cough came from there. θ Anemia of brain.
Great sensitiveness of abdomen and sore feeling.
Child complains of pain in belly when coughing.
Aching pain in abdomen during pregnancy, every night, after going to bed, > by getting up and moving about.
Writhing and grinding (searching) in umbilical region.
Pressing, aching pain in abdomen, with involuntary drawing of abdomen up towards thorax.
Pain in umbilical region as if bowels were bruised by blows.
Stitches extending from abdomen to right side of chest.
Pinching pains in abdomen, as if diarrhœa would set in.
Oft recurring, constricting pains in abdomen, coming and going at intervals, like labor pains.
Lancinations in abdomen as if knives were plunged in.
Griping in abdomen before discharge of leucorrhœa.
Painful abdominal spasms during menses.
Contractive labor-like colic from both sides of abdomen.
Colic from incarcerated flatus.
Cutting in abdomen before emission of flatus.
Colic during emission of flatus.
Colicky pains of a most violent kind.
Labor-like contractions ; pain in iliac regions.
Contractive pain in lower abdomen, like after-pains, with urging to stool.
Constrictive pains in lower part of abdomen.
Pain in hypogastric region during menses, going down legs.
Aching pain in hypogastric region, like menstrual colic.
Forcing down feeling in hypogastric region, like menstrual labor pains.
Bearing down pain and burning in hypogastric region. θ Uterine derangement.
Pains in groins as if swollen.
Tumors in abdomen.
Enlargement of mesenteric glands.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Con.]
Constant inclination to evacuate the bowels to relieve soreness.
Emissions of fetid or cold flatus.
Involuntary discharge of feces during sleep.
Diarrhœa. θ Vertigo.
Frequent diarrhœa and copious urination.
Slime, mixed with greenish substances and containing bloody specks ; stools are very small, offensive, with tenesmus and discharge of flatus during passage, with a weak, trembling feeling after ; no pain at all ; eight to fourteen stools daily, the passages becoming more frequent at night. θ Chronic dysentery.
Stools : liquid, fecal ; mingled with hard lumps ; watery, undigested, and passed with loud emissions of flatus, with colic ; liquid, diarrheic, with colic, discharge of flatus and much mucus or undigested food, or even blood ; undigested, painless ; painful ; hard, with tenesmus ; very debilitating ; frequent and sour ; streaked with blood ; with discharge of blood.
Diarrhœa only by day, not at night.
Chronic diarrhœa of old men.
Constipation and diarrhœa alternately. θ Uterine polypi.
Constipation alternating with bilious diarrhœa.
Stools sometimes regular, sometimes hard and tardy, or green and diarrheic. θ Enlargement of liver.
Frequent ineffectual urging to stool ; or small quantity passed each time.
Constipation, with ineffectual desire for stool ; constant urging, without stool.
Stools tardy, hard and dry. θ Cough.
Hard stool, with tenesmus, headache and discharge of prostatic fluid.

Hard stool every other day. θ Mental derangement.
Before stool : cutting abdominal pain.
During stool : burning, cutting and straining in rectum ; flatus ; prostatic juice ; rigors.
During stool a foreign body protrudes from the vulva. θ Uterine polypi.
After every stool, trembling, weakness and palpitation.
Heat in lower portion of rectum.
Frequent stitches in anus.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Con.]
Pain in kidneys if urine is restrained.
Sharp pressing in bladder.
Pressure upon bladder as if urine would come out immediately.
Pressure in neck of bladder, with stitches, < when walking, > when sitting.
Great pain in bladder, constant disposition to urinate, only a few drops passing at a time. θ Morning sickness.
Sharp stitches shortly after urinating in region of neck of bladder for many hours.
Shooting stitches in back part of urethra.
Burning, cutting and drawing through urethra while urinating.
Pain in urethra during micturition. θ Vertigo.
Immediately after urinating, burning in urethra, in morning.
Strangury.
Urine cannot be retained.
Constant urging to urinate, with heat on urinating.
Frequent micturition at night. θ Mental derangement.
Passing water does not relieve the desire to do so.
Urine clear as crystal and intermitting in its flow. θ Chronic dysentery.
Intermittent flow of urine with cutting after micturition.
Violent itching, the urine flowing and stopping alternately, at every emission.
Urine : clear as crystal ; thick ; white, turbid, with grey or white sediment ; mucous ; bloody.

Parenchymatous nephritis after scarlet fever.
Gravel.
Diabetes : accompanied by great pain ; with swelling and suppuration of left parotid gland.

Sexual desire without erection.
With weakness of sexual organs, much sexual erethism, amatory thoughts, even emissions provoked by mere presence of women.
Great sexual desire with partial or complete incapacity ; emissions on slightest provocation, melancholy.
Emissions without dreams.
Nightly emissions and spermatorrhœa ; urine flowing and stopping again at each passage of water.
Painful emission of semen.
Pollutions, with subsequent excitement of sexual desire.
Excessive pollutions, particularly of young people.
Excessive pollutions, with no history of previous excesses.
Bad effects from suppressed sexual desire, or from excessive indulgence.
Sexual weakness. θ Anemia of brain. θ Mental derangement.
Insufficient erection, lasting only a short time ; feeble embrace ; weakness after an embrace.
Impotence and want of erections.
Swelling and induration of testicles, particularly after contusion.
Cutting pain through scrotum to root of penis ; pressing and tearing pains in testes.
Chronic prostatic disease, the gland swollen, hard as stone, firmly fixed, and much biting-itching, or biting like flea-bites, a weight like a stone in perineum.

Very severe pains, coming on at night, waking from sleep ; orchitis from contusion swelling of testes ; firm hematocele, like a stone.
Recent cases of gonorrhœa with orchitis and severe nocturnal pains.
Indurated chancre of long standing.
Rheumatism after suppressed gonorrhœa.
Syphilitic sarcocele.

Ill effects of suppressed sexual instinct, or non-gratification of sexual appetite.
Induration and enlargement of ovaries or womb, with lancinating pains.
Indurations, especially of a scrofulous nature or from injuries.
Prolapsus uteri complicated with induration, ulceration and profuse leucorrhœa.
Uterus prolapsed and anteverted ; bearing down as though womb would be forced from vulva ; < when standing and walking, before and during menses ; dysmenorrhœa.
Induration of cervix ; sharp pains in part ; prolapsus uteri ; acrid leucorrhœa ; swelling of breasts ; stitches in breasts mostly at night.

Uterine spasms ; rigidity of os uteri.
A grinding pain is felt above pudendum ; the abdomen becomes inflated, the chest is affected and stitches are felt in left side.
Uterine spasm during too early and scanty catamenia, followed by leucorrhœa, with nightly pains, hysterical paroxysms.
Labor-like contractions.
Labor-like colic from both sides of abdomen.
Stitching pains in womb, with such symptoms as accompany pregnancy ; nausea and vomiting, craving sour or salt things ; pain and swelling of mamma during menses, dejection of spirits, etc.
Pinching and griping in uterus.
Stitches in uterus extend to right side of chest.
Burning, stinging, darting pains in neck of uterus, with indurations and scirrhosities.
Burning, sore, aching sensation in region of uterus.
Before menstruation : anxious dreams ; heat without thirst ; general bruised feeling, with inclination to weep ; restlessness and anxious apprehensiveness ; pains in breasts, with soreness and swelling ; stitches in liver ; distension.
Great soreness of breasts precedes menstruation ; < by least jar or walking.
Amenorrhœa : genitals very sensitive ; complicated with ovarian or uterine disease and chlorosis ; with venous abdominal hyperemia.
Brownish blood instead of menses.
During menstruation : great fears when alone, but dread of strangers or company ; labor-like abdominal pains, extending into thigh ; stitches in chest ; headache ; eruption ; stinging pains in neck of uterus.

Breasts relaxed, except at menstrual period.
Pressure from above downward, and drawing in legs during menses.
Menses too weak.

Dysmenorrhœa, with shooting pains in left chest, or sharp pains about heart.

Catamenia too late, scanty, and of short duration.
Menses : suppressed ; feeble, too late and scanty, of short duration.

Menses stopped by taking cold ; putting hands in cold water ; sour rising of food ; urine intermits ; nosebleed.
Every four weeks, great sensitiveness of labia majora and minora ; constant dry heat of body without thirst ; anxious dreams ; heaviness in all the limbs ; tearfulness ; restlessness ; anxious concern about trifles ; stitches in hepatic region, often lasting several days and greatly prostrating her, with entire absence of menstruation.
Violent itching of pudenda and vagina, especially after menses.
Leucorrhœa ten days after menses, stopping suddenly and soon flowing again, lasting several days, with much pain in bowels before discharge.
Acrid and burning leucorrhœa, white or yellow, preceded by griping and pinching pains in abdomen and lameness of small of back, followed by weariness.
Leucorrhœa : profuse ; bloody, mucous ; excoriating ; thick, milky, with contractive, labor-like colic, coming from both sides ; of white, acrid mucus, causing burning or smarting sensation.
Bearing down and stitches in vagina.
Severe itching deep in vagina.
Indurations of vulva from injuries.
Severe stitches in vulva.
Peculiar digging in vulva, a crampy pain.
Violent itching of vulva, followed by pressing down of uterus, especially after menses.
Sensitive pudenda and mammary glands.
Cutting pain between labia on micturition.
Sero-purulent eruption on mons veneris.
Large pimple on mons veneris, painful to touch.
Climaxis, with flushes of heat and sweat.
Shriveling of mamma, without sexual desire.
Fibroid tumors of uterus.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Con.]
Unready conception due to passive congestion.
Terrible nausea and vomiting in women suffering from scirrhosities during pregnancy.
Terrible nausea and vomiting during pregnancy.
Wakes in morning sick at stomach, vomiting several times from 5 o'clock till breakfast ; the substance vomited is white and frothy, followed by something yellow, like bile, < from raising head ; vomits several times during day ; three months pregnant.

Cough during pregnancy, < at night.
Obstinate cramps in stomach during pregnancy ; sensation of constriction, or of a heavy weight pressing upon stomach ; pains are constant but remittent in character, gradually growing so severe as to become unbearable ; constant dry, spasmodic cough which aggravates the cramps ; cough < from speaking, walking, or mental emotions.
Excessive heartburn at night while going to bed, in pregnant women.
Rigidity of os uteri during labor.

After-pains excited by child nursing, pains extending from left to right.
In first week after delivery, could not move head to turn over in bed on account of great vertigo.
Constant discharge of thin, watery milk from breasts for nine months after child has been weaned.
Induration of right mammary gland during lactation ; burning pain. θ Mastitis.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Con.]
Lisping voice.
Larynx sensitive to touch. θ Cough.
Dry spot in larynx, where there are crawling and almost constant irritation to cough.
Constant tickling and itching, dry, teasing cough.
Scraping in larynx, with irritation to cough, and dry cough in evening.
Hoarseness : cough and expectoration ; after leucorrhœa.
Blennorrhœa bronchialis.
Chronic cough from enlargement of bronchial glands, with irritation of tracheal and laryngeal lining.
Nervous bronchial asthma, paroxysmal, coming on in wet weather.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Con.]
Want of breath on taking least exercise and copious cough, with mucous discharge.
Shortness of breath when walking.
Constriction of chest, with dyspnœa. θ Cough.
Oppressed breathing in morning when waking.
Sawing, snoring breathing. θ Diphtheria after scarlatina.
Asthmatic paroxysms come on in wet weather ; face bluish-red.
Asthma in morning when awaking.
Nervous bronchial asthma.
Asthma of old people, with tickling cough.
Noise in larynx, which resembles very much an unarticulated "sha-li-sha-li" in sound ; this so disturbing that he must cease going to school ; marked spasmodic twitchings of muscles of right side of face ; these often precede the sounds ; spasmodic pressing pain in region of ligam. glottid. ; noise and twitchings of face < from talking, > by rest and sleep ; patient scrofulous and glands are swollen. θ Affection of inf. laryngeal nerve.
Bronchitis.
Catarrh, with dry, tickling cough, great lassitude, restlessness and thirst.
   

COUGH. [27] [Con.]
Unbearable titillation in pit of throat, with lisping voice, causing paroxysms of coughing.

Powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough excited by itching and tickling in chest and throat, or by a dry spot in larynx, < at night and when lying down, greatly fatiguing patient.
Dry cough, < towards morning, with constriction and oppression of chest.
Dry, tearing cough, persistent and annoying, < lying down, going out of warm room into air, and changing position in bed at night. θ Anemia of brain.
Dry, hacking, almost continuous cough ; < on lying down at night ; hardly any cough during day ; paroxysms of cough simulating whooping cough.
Especially dry, tickling cough in children and nightly cough of adults.
Cough, when first lying down, during day or evening ; is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Cough very much < by lying down ; in beginning many shocks of coughing as if he would vomit ; constant severe cough in evening on going to sleep.
Cough, wakes frequently at night out of a restless sleep, with stitching pains in sides of chest.
Dry, spasmodic, nightly, almost continually titillating cough, with violent oppression of chest and evening fever ; suffocating cough in scrofulous patients ; want of breath on taking least exercise and copious cough, with mucous discharge.
Chronic cough from enlargement of bronchial glands, or irritation of laryngeal lining ; dry, hacking, laryngeal cough.
Headache during violent coughing fits.
Lying down and taking a deep breath cause cough.
Sensation when coughing as if he must take hold of abdomen, feels as if cough proceeded from there. θ Anemia of brain.
Child complains of pain in belly when coughing.
Cough, with flatulency, dyspnœa, pain in limbs and on different places of chest, not < by the cough.
Cough with : stitches in head or chest ; shocks in head ; oppression and constriction of chest ; colic ; vomiting of mucus ; pain in abdomen.
Spasmodic cough after influenza, not ceasing until a mass of mucus is vomited.
After influenza : cough coming with no regularity, but more frequent at night than at any other time and continuing until retching and vomiting occur, expelling a small quantity of frothy mucus with a yellow nucleus.
Cough : loose, with inability to expectorate ; must swallow what is raised.
Whooping cough : expectoration only during day, with attacks of suffocation ; tickling in chest, shortness of breath, bloody mucus : difficulty in expectorating what has been loosened by cough, < at night.
Violent attacks of whooping cough in scrofulous children, face flushed, expectoration bloody.
Whooping cough if subacute bronchitis has supervened.
Expectoration : during day ; difficult ; bloody, purulent, sometimes hardened ; of putrid taste and smell, especially after measles, scarlatina, or during pregnancy.
Violent cough at night, with influenza.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Tickling sensation behind sternum.
Tight feeling in chest, > by cough.
Oppressive constriction of chest, with dry cough.
Violent oppression of chest and evening fever.
Pressure on chest, with spasmodic, tickling night cough.
Pains all over chest, with headache.
Itching, scraping, titillation under sternum, or in throat, causing periodic dry cough.
Sharp thrusts directly through chest, from sternum to spine, while sitting.
Stitches : in right chest about nipple, on every inspiration, while walking, < from hard pressure with hand ; in left side of chest, with uterine spasms ; from abdomen to right side of chest.
Jerks in chest.
Cutting pains in both sides of chest, < by inspiration ; tension and weakness in chest ; visible palpitation, especially after drinking.
Dull pain in left chest, tenth rib, < from coughing. θ Anemia of brain.
Hæmoptysis, or hemorrhage especially after masturbation, with tensive, pressing, stitching pains in chest.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Con.]
Precordial anguish.
Jerking sensation about heart.
Violent palpitation of heart. θ Morning sickness.
Violent palpitation after drinking, when rising from bed.
Palpitation after stool ; intermissions in beats of heart.

Aching or sharp pains about heart, with dysmenorrhœa.
Sensible beating of arteries through whole body.
Pulse : accelerated ; unequal in strength and sometimes irregular in rhythm ; irregular, generally slow and full, alternating with small and frequent beats ; extremely irregular, principally slow and large, but with intervening small and quick beats ; pulseless.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Con.]
The clothes lie like a weight on chest and shoulders.
Itching of breast and nipple, with red, scaly skin, and burning after rubbing.
Stitches as with needles in left mamma.
Stitching pain in sides of chest, with cough, which wakes him at night.
Violent stitches in left side of chest above nipple, on every inspiration while walking, not > by hard pressure of hand.
Violent stitches in right side, as if a knife was plunged into side, causing loud moaning. θ Pneumonia.
Beating stitch, with pain, in upper and left part of chest towards centre of chest.

The mammary glands painful in evening.
Pain in mamma, which often swell and become hard.
Hot pains through left breast and axilla. θ Uterine disorder.
Dull pain below left mamma. θ Prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Hardness of right mamma, with painfulness to touch, and nightly stitches in it.
Mammary induration following abscess of right mammary gland, remaining without change for two years.
Painful swelling of breast, about size of walnut.
Hard and painful lumps in mamma.
Tumor under left nipple as large as a hen's egg, moving freely under superficial fascia, and very hard and painful on pressure ; nipple inverted and sensitive to touch ; stinging, twinging pains ; leaden cast of areola.
Small and painless tumor in breast near nipple.
Tumors in mamma, with piercing pains, < at night, gland abnormally tender.
From contusion, hard lump as large as walnut on right side of nipple of right breast ; constant, dull, heavy pain in breast ; at night after spot has been irritated in any way, sharp and shooting pains.

Caries of sternum.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Con.]
Tightness in nape of neck ; pain and stiffness.
Soreness in lower cervical vertebræ.
Pain as from a sprain in left side of back and neck.
Enormously enlarged cervical glands. θ Caries lower jaw.
Cervical glands hard and tender.
Indurated and swollen cervical glands in scrofulous children.
Neck twisted by hard swelling to right shoulder. θ After scarlatina.
Herpetic eruption on neck and behind ears, < from heat, which causes a burning sensation.
Pain between shoulders and in lumbar region.
Weakness and lameness in small of back and subsequent lassitude.

Contraction in back, with sensation of coldness, griping and sore feeling.

Peculiar tumor in central part of back, as large as a cherry, growing on half an inch long pedicle ; tumor and pedicle of a bluish color.

Ill effects of bruises and shocks to spine.
Coccyodynia.
Upon buttocks small, scattered, flat, wart-like, greyish-brown growths of hypertrophied epidermis. θ Enlargement of liver.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Con.]
Shoulders feel bruised and sore.
Axillary glands swollen. θ Mammary tumor.
Arms when lifted fall like inert masses and remain immovable.
Humid tetters on forepart of arm.
Ichorous, biting, burning herpes on hands and forearms.
Cracking in wrist joint.
Sweat of palms of hands.
Itching on dorsum of finger.
Yellow spots on fingers.
Yellow nails.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Con.]
Drawing pain in hips.
Uneasiness in lower limbs.
Dragging and weakness in legs.
Pressing downward and drawing in thighs, scanty menses.
Numbness in thighs.
Sensation of weakness even to trembling, in right thigh while walking.
Staggering gait.
Painless loss of power in lower limbs ; faltering, vacillating gait ; staggers as if drunk, dragging his legs after him.
Lassitude in knees.
Pain in knee as from fatigue.
Herpetic eruption over popliteal space.
Pain going from hypogastric region down legs. θ Dysmenorrhœa.
Cracking of knee joint.
Cramps of calves.
Red spots on calves, turning yellow or green, as from contusion, preventing movement.
Liability of feet to catch cold from slight exposure.
Pustule on foot.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Con.]
Heaviness and sense of weariness in all limbs.
Limbs feel bruised.
Paralyzed feeling in all limbs.
Difficulty in using limbs ; unable to walk.
Unpainful lameness ; trembling of limbs.
Weakness and debility, especially of arms and legs.
Shooting pains through arms and legs. θ Uterine disorder.
Paralysis of lower, afterward of upper extremities, or the reverse.
Numbness of fingers and toes, the former looking as if they were dead.
All the joints pain as if beaten.
Piercing and tearing pains through extremities and in joints, particularly in elbows and hip joints.
Coldness of hands and feet.
Sensation as if bones of upper and lower extremities were surrounded by tight bands ; periostitis, with throbbing and burning pain, as if from an ulceration, < in morning and at night, also when standing, lying, or lifting the part, > when letting limb hang down and from motion ; r. side, or left upper and right lower.
   

REST. POSITION. MOTION. [35] [Con.]
Rest : > noise in larynx and twitchings of face.
Patient wishes to keep head perfectly still.
Letting limb hang down : > pain.
Lying down : vertigo < ; hydrocephalus, pains > ; aching in right eye ; cough < ; powerful, spasmodic paroxysms of cough < ; dry, tearing cough < ; dry, hacking, almost continuous cough < ; pain in bones <.
Must lie down : tearing in head.
Lying in bed : sick headache <.
Lying on side : <.
Recumbent position : tearing in temple and sides of head <.
Sitting : pressure in neck of bladder, with stitches > ; sharp thrusts directly through chest from sternum to spine ; sweat while dozing ; pain in ulcer.
Is obliged to sit up and cough it out, after which rest.
Patient < after going to bed, is obliged to sit up or walk about to get relief.

In morning : stitching in forehead ; headache on awaking ; asthenopia > ; agglutination of right eye ; pressure in eyes < ; awakens very sick at stomach and vomits several times, from 5 o'clock until breakfast ; fulness in abdomen when awaking early ; burning in urethra after urinating ; when awaking, oppressed breathing ; asthma when awaking ; pain in bones < ; sensation of debility when in bed ; sick and faint early, in bed ; stupid ; chill and coldness ; internal chill ; sweat.

At night : pains in eyes < ; stinging-tearing faceache sour belching < ; violent pains in stomach ; sudden attack of vomiting and diarrhœa ; hardness and distension of abdomen, with frequent sour evacuations < ; frequent micturition ; orchitis ; very severe pains coming on ; stitches in breasts ; between 12 and 3 must get up to urinate ; cough during pregnancy < ; excessive heartburn in pregnant women while going to bed ; tickling, dry cough, with violent headache, disturbed sleep ; powerful spasmodic paroxysms of cough ; dry, tearing cough, < on changing position in bed ; dry, hacking, almost continuous cough < on lying down ; cough wakes frequently out of a restless sleep, with stitching pains in sides of chest ; whooping cough < ; violent cough, with influenza < ; stitches in right mamma ; pains in tumors of mamma < ; sharp, shooting pains in right breast after any irritation ; pain in bones < ; pains in ulcers prevent sleep ; skin hot, burning in bed ; sweat ; pains in spine prevent sleep ; marasmus, with frequent sour belching < ; pain in uterus <.

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Con.]
Frequent : sneezing ; eructations, sour evacuations ; diarrhœa and copious urination ; ineffectual urging to stool ; stitches in anus ; uterine hemorrhages ; shocks in region of heart, attacks of apoplectic nature ; sour belching.

Every evening at 6 : dry, tickling cough, several hours.
Every night : after going to bed, aching in abdomen.
Every other day : hard stool.
Every fourteen days : great unhappiness of mind.
Every four weeks : great sensitiveness of labia.
Constant : inclination to sleep ; confusion of forehead ; inclination to swallow ; pain in liver ; inclination to evacuate bowels ; urging, without stool ; urging to urinate ; dry heat of body without thirst ; dry, spasmodic cough during pregnancy ; discharge of thin, watery milk from breasts nine months after child has been weaned ; irritation to cough in larynx ; severe cough in evening ; dull, heavy pain in right breast ; desire to change position.

LOCALITY AND DIRECTION. [42] [Con.]
Right : as of a large foreign body in half of brain ; tearing in side of head ; eye bloodshot, aches on lying down, agglutination in morning ; pinching in ear ; bleeding from side of nose ; lacerating in half of face ; small and large pustules on cheek ; aching in hypochondrium ; pressing in hypochondriac region, with swelling extending towards precordial region and nearly to crest of ilium ; induration of mammary gland, with burning pain ; spasmodic twitchings of muscles of side of face ; stitches about nipple on every inspiration ; violent stitches as if a knife were plunged into side ; hardness of mamma, with painfulness to touch, and nightly stitches in it, mammary induration following abscess of mammary gland ; after contusion of breast, hard lump as large as walnut ; constant, dull, heavy pain in breast ; after contusion of breast, uneven swelling, axillary glands swollen, dull stitches in breast ; neck twisted by, hard swelling to shoulder ; weakness, even to trembling in thigh.
Left : clicking in vertex ; redness of sclerotic, dimness of cornea ; in hypochondrium ; stitches in side ; shooting pain in chest ; dull pain in chest, tenth rib ; stitches as with needles in mamma ; hot pains through breast and axilla ; dull pain below mamma ; tumor under nipple ; scirrhus of breast ; pain as from a sprain in side of back and neck.

From within outward : stitching in forehead ; shocks in ears ; stitches in ear.
From above downward : pressure during menses.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Con.]
As though a great grief weighed upon him ; as though bed was turning in a circle ; as of looseness in head ; as of a large heavy lump in brain ; as if something like a fringe was falling down over eyes ; as if something had become detached on shaking head ; as if brain had gone to sleep ; as if both temples were compressed ; as of a foreign body under skull ; as if occiput was pierced with a knife, with every pulse ; as of a large foreign body in right half of brain ; as if head had been bruised, and as if a load was pressing down on it ; as if head was too full and would burst ; as if head had been bruised by blows or would fall to pieces ; as of catarrh in head ; as if eyes were trembling ; as if eyeball was swollen ; as if eyes were pulled outward from nose ; as of overpowering giddiness coming over her ; as of a grain of sand in eyes, in outer canthus ; as if eyelids were pressed down by a heavy weight ; as if ears were stopped up on blowing nose ; as if teeth were loose ; as if a round body was ascending œsophagus, from stomach ; as of a gentle heat passing from stomach through arms to fingers, and then hands appear as if dead ; as if stomach contracted ; of a heavy burden upon stomach ; as of a constricted band about hypochondria ; as if he must take hold of abdomen when coughing ; as if cough came from abdomen ; as if bowels were bruised by blows ; as if diarrhœa would set in ; as if knives were plunged into abdomen ; as if groins were swollen ; as if urine would come out immediately ; as though womb would be forced from vulva ; as of a heavy weight pressing upon stomach ; as if knife was being thrust through occiput with each pulsation of heart ; as if a knife was plunged into right side ; as from a sprain in l. side of back and neck ; as if shoulders were bruised and sore ; as from fatigue in knees ; as if limbs were bruised ; as if beaten, in all the joints ; as if bones of upper and lower extremities were surrounded by tight bands ; as from an ulceration, in limbs ; as if paralyzed after a short walk ; as if part affected by ulcer was beaten to pieces.

Ulcers : cancerous ; scabby ; destitute of feeling ; with tight, tense feeling ; speckled.
Scurfy exanthema ; polypus ; greenish mortification ; tetters in general.
Edges of ulcer become black ; gangrene of parts of ulcer ; creeping, with a tensive pain ; ulcers which are bluish have a livid appearance and are tumid ; pain in part as if it was beaten to pieces ; swollen ulcers, hard to heal ; inflamed ulcers, with a feeling of soreness.
Bleeding from ulcers.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Con.]
Cannot take alcoholic stimulants ; easily intoxicated.
Strong persons of a sedentary habit are affected more than lively and slender persons and children.
Suited to women of rigid fibre, easily excited, as well as to those of opposite temperament.
Hypochondriacal old maids ; old, weak and feeble men.
Especially useful to old people, and among these to women more than to men.
Light-haired persons.
Debility of old people ; diseases caused by a blow or fall ; cancerous and scrofulous people, with tight rigid fibre.
Scrofulous constitutions ; strumous condition, enlarged glands.
Apoplectic paralysis.
Children who are prematurely old ; with marasmus, with frequent sour evacuations, < during night, > by day.
Girl, æt. 4 ; diphtheria after scarlatina.
HS., æt. 4 1/2, had jaundice two years ago ; ophthalmia.
Girl, æt. 6, of scrofulous constitution, had suffered for a long time from ulcer on right great toe, which had healed up for ten months ; she had also cicatrix resulting from suppuration of glands on neck and lower jaw ; seven months after healing of ulcer, inflammation of eyes.
Girl, æt. 10 ; cough.
Boy, æt. 13, noise in larynx, with twitching of muscles of face ; allopathic treatment of no avail ; Bellad. given without result ; under old school treatment had received Conium without effect.
Young man, æt. 16, strong and healthy ; derangement of mind.
Girl, æt. 16, tissues flabby, scrofulous, menstruated one year ; swelling of lids.
Young lady, æt. 18, lymphatic, scrofulous constitution ; photophobia.
Susanna F., æt. 19, robust, of slender form, perfectly developed, affected from infancy with ophthalmia ; inflammation of eyes.
Robust girl, æt. 20, suffering formerly from swelling of lymphatics and eruptions on head ; herpetic eruption.
Woman, æt. 22, delicate, but healthy ; for five years after contusion scirrhus of left breast.
Miss G., æt. 25, has always had dysmenorrhœa ; prolapsus and dysmenorrhœa.
Girl, æt. 26 ; suffering since childhood from herpes.
Woman, æt. 27, pale, scrofulous appearance ; cramps in stomach during pregnancy.
Miss A. P., æt. 28 ; dysmenorrhœa.
Woman, æt. 30, otherwise healthy ; half year after contusion of right breast, tumor.
Ammon S., æt. 32, well developed, strong looking, five feet four inches in height, sick with peritonitis after having for a year felt tired and overworked, convalescence slow and protracted ; anemic state of brain.
Woman, æt. 33, married ; uterine disorder.
Mrs. B., æt. 35, fell, striking right breast on back of chair, causing a hard tumor.
Young man, tuberculous, after attack of catarrh ; dry, tickling cough.
Young man, after falling from second story upon back ; pain in lower part of back and in region of small of back.
Lady, accomplished, lively ; melancholia.
Strong, corpulent woman ; scirrhus in mamma.
Woman, weak, excitable ; galactorrhœa.
Mrs. G., æt. about 40 ; tumor of left breast of six or seven years standing.
Mrs. F., æt. 40 ; tumor on breast.
Edward S., a Russian, æt. 45, formerly soldier in United States army, and under allopathic treatment ; dysentery of four years' standing.
Woman, æt. 48 ; vertigo.
Woman, æt. 48, nervous constitution ; enlargement of liver.
A. man, æt. 48 ; first threatened softening of brain, helped by Laches., then right-sided paralysis, particularly facial, helped by Caustic., afterwards diabetes mellitus of two years' standing, with swelling and suppuration of left parotid and profuse sweat with insomnia.
Woman, æt. 54, plethoric ; uterine polypi.
Mrs. S. R., æt. 54, and Mrs. C. N., æt. 62 ; scirrhous cancer of breast.
Man, æt. 60 ; after injury to eye by a splinter of wood, traumatic inflammation.
Woman, æt. 60 ; cancer of stomach.
Lady, æt. 67, unmarried ; cough.
Woman, æt. 74, paralyzed many years on left side ; cough.
Mrs. ---, æt. 75 ; pain in chest during pneumonia.
   

RELATIONS. [48] [Con.]
Antidoted by : Coffea, Dulcam., Nitr. ac., Nitr. spir. dulc.
It antidotes : Mercur. (swelling of lymphatics) ; Nitr. ac., Sulphur. (swollen glands).
Compatible : Arnic. (contusions) ; Arsen. (cancer) ; Bellad. (incipient amaurosis, cerebro-spinal irritation, cancer) ; Calcar. (scrofula, lymphatic enlargement) ; Droser. (pertussis) ; Lycop., Nux vom., Phosphor., Pulsat., Rhus tox. (contusions) ; Stramon. (sexual debility).
Wine and spirits often improve the sick who require Conium, though it suits persons who cannot take alcoholic stimulants.
Compare : Arnic., Arsen., Bar. carb. (lymphatic swellings) ; Bellad., Calcar., Cicut., Coffea, Droser., Dulcam., Lycop., Mag. mur., Mercur., Nitr. ac., Nitr. spir. dulc., Nux vom., Phosphor., Pulsat., Rhus tox., Stramon., Sulphur, Valer.
